reason: My helper does most of the cooking and I just order from Talabat or Breadfast when something runs out. I would not scan receipts or track expiry, it is a chore for no real gain.
objection: My helper manages the kitchen, not an app. Getting her to scan receipts and use a shared list is extra work, and I rarely plan ahead anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it connected straight to my delivery orders on Talabat or Noon so the kitchen fills itself without me scanning anything.
